title: Despite description, these DEFINITELY warp ...
text:
Despite description, these DEFINITELY warp .... These pans are the perfect size for my toaster oven, but they warp terribly at 350F or higher (haven't tried them at lower temps yet, but I'm not hopeful). The warping is severe: 1.5" on one corner (will post a picture later ... ).

I can still use them for some uses, but not if the degree of warping will interfere with the evenness of the bake. They work great for reheating things like pizza or baking a few cookies, but I wouldn't use them with anything that has a significant amount of liquid as it probably wouldn't stay in the pan.

I'm giving them 3 stars -- they're OK, but it's obvious that whoever wrote the product info here had never used them for actually baking something. I can still use them for some things, so I won't return them.
